# cursor-model-orchestrator

> Recommend-only Cursor Pro model router skill (YAML tiers, Russian [route] line, Other Models budget).

Classifies prompts with deterministic rules and recommends a cost-aware model. Overlay on Auto/Router — does not force the picker. MIT.

## Profiles

- **core** (default): standalone routing; no Hindsight/GitNexus required
- **stack**: soft Hindsight retain when MCP server `hindsight` is up; optional GitNexus hints

Stack Hindsight lifecycle (not this repo): https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-hindsight-ondemand

- [README](https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-model-orchestrator#readme): install, core vs stack, FAQ

## Install (short)

```powershell
pwsh -File .\scripts\install_skill.ps1 -Profile core
# or: -Profile stack  then install cursor-hindsight-ondemand
```

## Not included

Hindsight daemon wrappers, GitNexus index/MCP product code, and forcing Cursor's model picker are out of scope.
